title: Azure Pipelines Ubuntu 22.04 hosted image is scheduled for removal
summary: The Ubuntu 22.04 hosted image deprecation starts on 2026-09-17 and its scheduled removal is 2027-04-17, per Microsoft's hosted image deprecation schedule.

constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. The Ubuntu 22.04 schedule does not apply to self-hosted Ubuntu 22.04 agents.
Move off ubuntu-22.04 before the scheduled removal on 2027-04-17. The notice names ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04, or ubuntu-26.04.

steps.title: Retarget the hosted image
steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from ubuntu-22.04 to ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04, or ubuntu-26.04 (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools
steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins ubuntu-22.04. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.

verification.purpose: Lint .gitlab-ci.yml with gitlab-ci-lint, or .circleci/config.yml with circleci config validate, when the repository has that file. Azure Pipelines has no equivalent local validator: queue the pipeline and confirm the job uses the replacement vmImage.
